reason: Retained Windows-to-container PostgreSQL connection timeout. Keep network isolation and move the test client onto the same internal network.
prebuild_gate: No image build. Verify installed Linux/AMD64 identities; runner refuses anything other than Linux CPython 3.14 before installation. Stop without replacement downloads if incompatible.

proposed_download.kind: six pinned binary wheels from official PyPI file URLs
proposed_download.execution: Install only the six verified wheels offline into 192 MiB container tmpfs, not Windows, sibling environments or a new permanent image. No dependency resolution, sources or install hooks.

proposed_runtime.network: Dedicated internal network, no published ports, no host network and no external access during execution.
proposed_runtime.mounts: Sanitized selected source snapshot read-only; dedicated credentials; separate writable evidence directory; no other projects or Docker socket.
proposed_runtime.shutdown: Independent ownership-checked watchdog for both components; retain databases and failed receipts; no global prune or unrelated shutdown.
proposed_runtime.temporary_storage: Runner: 64 MiB noexec scratch storage plus 128 MiB executable dependency tmpfs, nosuid/nodev, owner 10001, mode 0700, same 192 MiB aggregate temporary storage and 512 MiB container RAM cap. Install only cached hash-verified wheels. Database temporary mounts remain noexec.
proposed_runtime.disk_growth: Twelve GiB whole-stage guard, same conservative initial baseline including prior consumption, twenty-five GiB reserve; detection guard rather than hard quota.
proposed_runtime.pretest_gate: Inspect effective image, memory/swap/CPU/process limits, user, privileges, capabilities, restart policy, exact private mounts, internal network and no published ports before releasing the test gate.
